📚 Accounts Register
Keep all your books here — Sales, Purchase, Receipts, and (in future) any other transaction register. View, edit, cancel, restore, duplicate, or delete any entry.
📒 Chart of Accounts
Every invoice, receipt, purchase, payment, and journal you save automatically posts here — this is the real, double-entry backbone behind your Financial Reports. Customers you've already added double as their own ledger under Sundry Debtors/Creditors automatically; add any other ledgers you need below (e.g. a specific bank account, or an expense category).
Bringing in a new Chart of Accounts (e.g. a fresh Tally export)? Clear the current one first so old and new ledgers don't mix.

Settings — Numbering, Tax & Declaration

Business start

Used as the default earliest date across reports and as a reference point for your books. It does not block older entries.

Invoice numbering

Only applies to the first invoice issued in a calendar year that has none yet — it will never renumber invoices you've already issued.

Quotation numbering

Receipt numbering

Chart of Accounts numbering

New ledgers you add under Chart of Accounts will be numbered automatically starting from this code.

Defaults for new invoices

Shown on every taxable invoice. Required for GST/VAT compliance in most jurisdictions.

Default ledgers (Chart of Accounts)

These pre-select the account used to post new item lines, discounts, and other charges to your books — you can still change any of them per document. Add more ledgers under Chart of Accounts first if you don't see the one you want here.

Bank details (shown on invoices, with a payment QR code)

Leave bank fields blank to hide the bank-details box on invoices entirely. The QR code is generated live by a free public QR service each time an invoice is viewed, printed, or downloaded — it is not stored in this file.

Company seal & signature

Use this if your seal and signature are already one image. It's placed as-is (no extra rotation added), sized to fit neatly above "Authorised Signatory". When this is uploaded, the two separate images below are not used.
Uploaded images are saved immediately and will appear above "Authorised Signatory" on every invoice and receipt from now on.

Demo Data

Testing / trying things out?
Wipes everything currently in this browser — customers, cost centres, sales people, chart of accounts, and every invoice/quotation/receipt/purchase/payment/journal — and loads a fresh set of realistic sample data so you can click around and test freely. Your company profile, login accounts, and seal/signature are kept.
Ready to start real work?
Removes only the sample/demo records, leaving any real customers, invoices, etc. you've already entered untouched. Use this once you're done testing.

Users & Access (sign-in)

Only an Owner can add, remove, or change users.
UsernameRoleActions
Owner and Admin: full access to everything, including Settings, Reports, and Dashboard. Only an Owner can manage other users.
Data Entry: can create, save, print, download, and share invoices and receipts — but cannot open Reports, the Dashboard, or Settings.
This is a basic access gate, not real security — anyone able to view this file's source could bypass it.

Shared data & logins (automatic sync)

Paste this once (one-time setup in Google Sheets — see the companion setup guide provided with this file) and everything after that is automatic: users you add here can log in on their own device immediately, and customers/invoices/receipts stay in sync in the background. Nobody needs to click anything to push or pull — it just happens. Leave blank to keep this device's data fully local/offline. A live sync status indicator is always shown in the top toolbar.
Existing saved documents keep their original number and won't change. New numbers you issue after saving these settings will use the updated prefix/suffix.
